SMTO-WEB-0050 — SMTO is already waiting for your answer about more research

GUID: 39aac25d-56ab-5d19-96f9-b198fae66e9a
Slug: research-budget-request-pending
Domain: WEB · Subsystem: web_research

What happened

  • SMTO has already asked whether it may do more web searches or page reads, and that question is still open. It didn't ask twice, and it won't do those extra lookups until you answer.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Find the Continue research prompt in the conversation and select Allow these additional steps or Don't allow. SMTO is paused on that question and continues as soon as you answer.
  2. If you can't see the prompt, refresh the page and look again. The waiting question is saved, so it shows up again after the page reloads.

What success looks like

  • After you answer, SMTO either continues researching or finishes with what it has.

If it still fails

  • If no prompt appears even after refreshing, select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • request_research_budget found an equivalent budget request (same intent revision and budget keys) already in the prompted state, so no second prompt was opened.

What this means

  • An equivalent budget request is already in the prompted state. This decision changes no acquisition outcome and does not itself perform external access. Existing user decisions, intent scope and hard bounds remain authoritative.

Why this can happen

  • An equivalent budget request is already in the prompted state.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the existing pending request identity instead of creating a second prompt.

How to fix it

  • budgets.request() returns research_budget_request_pending when budget_requests[key] is prompted. Wait for answer_in() to settle the existing authority request; do not open another prompt or start acquisitions that need the extension while it is pending.
  • Wait for the existing user decision; do not open another prompt.

Retry and execution caution

  • Wait for the existing user decision; do not open another prompt.

How to verify the fix

  • The original decision is recorded once and continuation uses its authorized result.

What not to do

  • Do not start acquisitions that require the extension while its decision is pending.

Technical notes

  • This decision changes no acquisition outcome and does not itself perform external access. Existing user decisions, intent scope and hard bounds remain authoritative.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
